style: Narrate this product demo like a calm, confident documentary voiceover. Warm, clear, measured pace, slight emphasis on numbers:

segments.text: Maria's insurer denied her glucose monitor using a rule Medicare deleted in 2021.
Medicare Advantage plans deny three point two million requests a year. Fewer than one in eight gets appealed, yet four in five appeals win.
Overturn sends six Gemini agents through the denial, the exact Medicare policy version, and her chart.
Two of the plan's requirements were retired by Medicare. A third exists in no version of the policy at all.
Here's the receipt: the policy itself, showing that rule removed in July 2021.
Every criterion links a policy sentence to a line in her chart. Change a single word, and Overturn refuses to send.
Plain code, not the model, decides every violation, each one cited to federal regulation.
A human reviews and signs, and a fax-ready appeal is done in about two minutes.
Two point eight million denials a year go unfought. Overturn them.
